notes: Casino: a new 10× button spins the slots 10 times in a row with all ten results lined up (press it again to stop). A jackpot ends the run and is announced to everyone straight away, even with fast spins, and your points in the corner match your real balance. Blackjack: while a player is dealing, bets are capped at 1,000. A player dealer who busts on purpose gets a strike; 3 strikes in a day and they're off the dealer seat until tomorrow.
